lastCompletedStory.title: Accept and persist type through cam spec --persist

nextStoryContext: US-003 (grill capture/confirm type, both /cam-spec command copies) should prompt the operator/orchestrator during the grill for one of feat|fix|chore|docs and include it as a top-level `type` key in the JSON payload piped to `cam spec --persist <id>` (alongside spec/wsjf/blockedBy). specifyIssueOnMain (src/commands/issue-specify.ts) and the SpecPersistPayload pass-through (src/commands/spec.ts) already accept and validate an optional `type` end-to-end (US-002, CAM-235): validateIssueType in src/issues/spec.ts rejects any value outside the 4-item enum with reason:'invalid-type', and a payload without type leaves the issue entry without a type key (no default is written -- 'feat' defaulting is deferred to US-004 planner / US-005 composePrTitle, not this story or US-002). US-003 only needs to change the two command-doc copies (.claude/commands/cam-spec.md + templates/commands/cam-spec.md, or wherever the grill's persist-payload construction is spec'd) to solicit and forward the type field; no further src/ validation work is needed on the persist path.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Pure TypeScript validation (enum membership check) + conditional object-spread mutation; no external library API was exercised. Mirrors the existing validateSpecSource precedent already in src/issues/spec.ts.
